name: STAR Geodesy — transverse Mercator and UTM
summary: Transverse Mercator and UTM coordinates, forward and inverse, by Krueger's series; within 2e-7 m of PROJ and PyGeodesy on 600 points in their zone and 2.5e-7 m of PROJ up to 12 deg from the central meridian; reproduces Snyder's published example and refuses out-of-range input.
reference: Snyder, Map Projections - A Working Manual (USGS PP 1395), p. 269: Clarke 1866, central meridian 75 W, k0 0.9996, 40.5 N 73.5 W: x = 127106.5 m, y = 4484124.4 m
reference_observed: (127106.467, 4484124.434): within 0.034 m of the printed values (printed to 0.1 m)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees and metres; zone, hemisphere letter, easting, northing; false origins stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; Newton iteration capped at 8 steps; grid exceptions documented as not applied
